entries.scope: Pinned Home Baseline source and explicit ADE Home Runtime sync
entries.rationale: The canonical container path, optional source override, explicit runtime command, persistence behavior, and security boundary change for learners and maintainers.
entries.navigationImpact: No new portal; existing setup, learner profile, and security paths document the new canonical source name and runtime command.
entries.languageStrategy: German first and English second in synchronized sections, at approximately CEFR B2.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: Compose commands were resolved on macOS with Podman; container runtime commands execute on Linux. Windows and native Linux host lifecycle checks remain platform-specific CI or maintainer coverage.
entries.risk: Medium; an explicit apply operation writes manifest-defined files to the container home and selected persistent agent volumes, while credentials and local settings must remain unchanged.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: The Level-0 manifest, runtime wrapper modes, Home links, persistence mounts, or container sync protection changes.
